name: What should I expect to pay for residential remodeling, and what makes the price go up?

mainEntity.name: What should I expect to pay for residential remodeling, and what makes the price go up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on square footage, material choices, labor complexity, and whether the project includes repair work behind the walls. The biggest value question is whether you are paying for a simple finish update or a deeper remodel that corrects damage and improves the home long term.
acceptedAnswer.description: Price is driven by size, materials, labor, and hidden repair issues. A deeper remodel or restoration job will cost more than a surface-level update.
